posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Reigned as 'undisputed queen' at Cannes 2026 with a stunning sapphire blue sculptural gown by Amit Aggarwal and a blush pink couture look, with daughter Aaradhya joining her on the red carpet in a satin red ensemble.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: At the center of a Cannes 2026 storm — faced online trolling for her red carpet walk and outfits but found defenders rallying behind her. Confirmed for Tumbbad 3 and addressed gender representation in Indian cinema.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 made history as the first Hindi film to cross ₹1000 crore net, becoming the biggest Indian grosser in the UK. OTT premiere on JioHotstar confirmed for June 4.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Filming action thriller 'King' with daughter Suhana Khan and Deepika Padukone, set for a blockbuster Christmas 2026 release. KKR facing Delhi Capitals in their final IPL 2026 match today.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Rural sports drama 'Peddi' generating massive buzz ahead of June 4 release — AR Rahman performed a live concert in Bhopal to launch the 'Hellallallo' track. Also went viral for apologizing to Jasprit Bumrah after calling him a 'footballer.'

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Met RCB's Venkatesh Iyer after the IPL 2026 SRH match and gifted his son a signed jersey. Collaboration with director Basil Joseph confirmed — and it's not Shaktimaan.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Imtiaz Ali's Partition love story 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' is getting rave reviews, with Ektaa R Kapoor calling it 'emotional and timeless.' Diljit stars alongside Vedang Raina and AR Rahman's score.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Shooting the mega-budget epic 'Varanasi' in Hyderabad — set to be one of the most expensive Indian films ever at ₹1,000-1,300 crore. Also confirmed for Hrithik Roshan's Krrish 4.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Using a body double for action sequences in both Allu Arjun's 'Raaka' and SRK's 'King' due to pregnancy. Sai Pallavi confirmed as her replacement in the Kalki sequel.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: In talks for a Hollywood debut with Mortal Kombat producer Lawrence Kasanoff for an inter-parallel universe action epic. Father David Dhawan got emotional at the 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' trailer launch.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Set to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's superhero film — marking Salman's first superhero role. Production expected to begin in October 2026 with a 2027 release.

posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Wished director Rohit Shetty a happy birthday amid ongoing rift rumors. Viral photos with Vicky Kaushal and their newborn son continue to delight fans.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Director Prashanth Neel revealed NTR lost 15 kg in just four months for his intense assassin role in 'Dragon.' The teaser broke records with 64M+ YouTube views in 24 hours.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: In talks to play the female lead opposite Vicky Kaushal in the mythological drama 'Mahavatar.' Also announced the animated film 'Chhoti Stree' ahead of Stree 3.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Shared a heartwarming photo of her baby daughter with Sidharth Malhotra. Shut down 'absolute nonsense' rumors about requesting changes to the Yash-starrer 'Toxic,' and is set to headline the Madhubala biopic.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Romance film 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya hit theaters this week — opened at ₹3.31 crore and saw a 21% Day 2 jump despite mixed reviews calling it a messy but moving Gen-Z love story.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Deleted a leaked 'Cocktail 2' song 'Tujhko' from social media, sparking fan speculation about marketing strategy. Shooting the sequel with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon while her fierce 'Mysaa' first look creates buzz.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Featured alongside Shruti Haasan in the high-energy 'Hellallallo' track from Ram Charan's 'Peddi,' launched at AR Rahman's Bhopal concert. Film arrives June 4.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Producing and starring in 'Maa Inti Bangaram' with Gulshan Devaiah making his Telugu debut. Her comeback after the myositis battle continues to inspire fans across industries.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Making his directorial debut with Krrish 4 — Priyanka Chopra confirmed to reprise her role. The superhero sequel is in production at YRF with a planned 2027 release.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Performed a massive live concert at Bhopal's BHEL Dussehra Ground to launch 'Hellallallo' from Ram Charan's 'Peddi.' Also praised his 'epic' collaboration with Hans Zimmer on Ramayana.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Final film 'Jana Nayagan' still awaiting CBFC certification — producer says release date coming soon once clearance arrives. The political actioner marks his farewell before full-time politics as Tamil Nadu CM.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Bollywood's melody queen gearing up for 'The Unstoppable Tour' US concerts later this year. Continues to dominate playback with contributions to Battle of Galwan and other major soundtracks.
